prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1241; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with a diagnosed wrist fracture confirmed on imaging and supported by consistent findings on physical examination. Care was delivered over twenty visits, consisting of immobilization, serial radiographs, progressive range-of-motion exercises, and follow-up assessment of grip strength and function. The duration of treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for a fracture of this type, which we attribute to slower healing progression and the patient's gradual return to daily activities. The patient reports no prior injury to the same area, and our records do not reflect any earlier complaints involving this wrist. At this point it remains unclear whether the fracture is fully attributable to the reported collision, and further review of the mechanism of injury may be warranted. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor healing and functional recovery.
